items.title: Base change statements can be checked after an etale covering that factors through etale morphisms to the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma reduces base change statements for sheaves, for bounded complexes and for the q-th direct images to the members of an etale covering whose pieces factor through etale morphisms to the base (statement lines 16306-16337). The proof (proof lines 16339-16370) computes the restriction of both sides to each piece by locality of pushforward and pullback, concludes by the covering property, and repeats the argument with the higher-direct-image locality statement for the other two parts. H2: one locality computation applied to three statements, written out.
